g.srcs: FSA 2026 ARC-CO benchmark yields (county file of Jan 16, 2026); FSA county average PLC yields, program year 2025; FSA price tables of Nov 10, 2026; USDA WASDE, Nov 10, 2026; Dec 2027 corn and Nov 2027 soybean close of Nov 25, 2026; USDA NASS season-average prices for closed marketing years; FSA ARC-CO county files, program years 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 (county yields and payments)
g.asof: <time class="asof" data-asof="" data-asof-prefix="Data updated" datetime="2026-11-25">Data updated Nov 25, 2026</time>
g.ask: Ask the county FSA office for “the 2026 ARC-CO benchmark yield for my county, crop and practice (irrigated or non-irrigated)”, or look it up in FSA’s program data (file: ARC-CO benchmark yields and revenues, program year 2026). Then type it into the calculator.
dl: Do nothing for 2026 and that farm gets no 2026 payment.
A 2025 law added 30 million base acres nationwide. More acres qualified than that cap, so FSA cut every new allocation by 3.69%.
Producers with a share in the crop sign. FSA says a landowner with no share interest, such as a cash-rent landlord, cannot enroll.
Bring the farm’s FSA-156EZ. It lists the base acres and PLC yields.

corn.c7: corn $4.64 (Dec '27 corn futures $4.85 (Nov 25, 2026) times 0.959: from 2011 to 2025, every year of RMA price history on file, the final season-average price averaged 0.959 times that year’s February average of the harvest contract (RMA’s projected price))

soybeans.c7: soybeans $11.59 (Nov '27 soybean futures $11.86 (Nov 25, 2026) times 0.978: from 2011 to 2025, every year of RMA price history on file, the final season-average price averaged 0.978 times that year’s February average of the harvest contract (RMA’s projected price))

wheat.meth: Price range from how far USDA’s November wheat price missed the final season-average price, 2015 to 2025 (11 years); for 2015 to 2018 USDA printed a range, and we use its middle.

seed_cotton.hub: FSA’s seed cotton price is its own weighted average of the upland cotton lint price and the cottonseed price. We use FSA’s seed cotton series as published and never build it from the lint price. All seed cotton counties.
